title: Platform construction.
officialText:
Platforms on all working levels of a scaffold shall be fully planked or decked between the front
uprights and the guardrail system supports in accordance with Sections 3314.5.1 through 3314.5.6.
Exception: Platforms used solely as walkways or used solely by workers installing or removing the scaffold shall be planked to
the extent necessary to ensure the safety of the public and property.
